page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Running head centred at the top. Printed page number at the top right. Below the last text line, catchword at the right and gathering signature at the left-centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: causa cur tali chartæ nihil inscribatur, resp. est à penna non-denigrante : abfentia denigrationis, & abfentia non-denigrationis artificiosæ est à scribente artem suam negante. Ideoque ex hac Dei causatione sequitur nuda non conversio physica & negativa, non proprie conversio privativa & culpabilis. Nam ex causa præcise physica non sequitur ullo modo culpa. Culpa enim est defectus moralis, ideoque ortum habere non potest, nisi ex causa morali & deficiente: ideoque ex non appositione fulcri physice sequitur ruina ædium physica ut habet similitudo Arm.Si dominus teneatur ædes servo suo suppositis fulcris sustentare, casus ædium moraliter imputatur domino non apponenti fulcra, quæ ex pacto aut data fide apponere debuit, & hoc posteriore sensu simile Arminianū urget, & tamen nihil concludit.

Deus enim ex debito neminem convertit, sed ex beneplacito suo.' Secundo modo, si consideretur Deus, ut agens ex beneplacito suo, cujusmodi agens tantum hic est Deus, nullo modo imputatur moraliter non-conversio Deo. Non enim pacto, statuto aut ullo officio Deus se astrinxit ad homines convertendos. Nam non extat statutum aut pactum illud Dei ex promissione ulla [hoc fac, & ego te efficaciter vocabo:] [qui hoc fecerit, conversionis mercedem facti in laboris compensationem repertabit.] Iam quoniam hoc in tota scriptura, aut ex ullo Dei attributo Arminiani, & Iesuitæ ad hunc usque

page.notes: Printed "Hh 5" at the foot read as a signature; the 5 is slightly unclear. Printed "fuo.'" in the second paragraph carries a closing quote mark as printed. Line-end hyphens are kept: deni-, ar-, pro-, te-, non-con-, con-, la-, quo-, and the hyphen in "sus-ten-" is joined as "sustentare" across the line break, with the printed hyphen kept at the line end. Long s and s are rendered as plain s throughout. Bracketed text "[hoc fac ... repertabit.]" is printed in square brackets in the original.
